Price your trip

Scottsdale Sprinters prices every vehicle by the hour, from $125 to $325, with its minimum shown up front. A 5-hour evening in the Executive Black Sprinter (seats 14) is $725 before tax — about $52 per person when the group splits it.

How much does a party bus or Sprinter cost in Scottsdale?

Every vehicle is booked by the hour, not by the mile. Published rates run from $125 to $325 an hour, and each one shows its minimum before you book. A 5-hour evening in the Executive Black Sprinter, which seats 14, comes to $725 before tax, about $52 a head once the group splits it.

What does it work out to per person?

Divide the fare by the seats. A 5-hour booking in the Executive Black Sprinter (14 seats) is about $52 a person; in the 56-Passenger Motorcoach it is about $29. You book the vehicle and never a seat, so the total never changes with headcount, and the fare is the same full or half empty.

How is the total calculated?

Your fare is the hourly rate times billable hours, and nothing else. Billable hours are the hours you book, less any free hours earned, never below the vehicle minimum of 4 to 5 hours. Tax of 8% is added at checkout, and the deposit depends on how you pay. There is no service fee, fuel surcharge or per-seat price.

Do prices change for Barrett-Jackson, the Phoenix Open, wedding season or prom?

The table on this page shows the current published hourly rates. January auction week, the February golf tournament, spring wedding season and April prom nights are quoted from it, on the same 4 to 5 hour vehicle minimums. What varies by date is availability, so request a current quote from our reservations team.
